title: Keep the local dashboard live and truthful
summary: The local dashboard no longer presents completed snapshots as running agents. Active work is derived from locked plans, snapshot/plan/repository data refetches automatically, browser caching is disabled for dynamic API responses, and the snapshot index invalidates immediately when a new snapshot is added.
userVisibleChange: The overview now clears finished agents automatically, shows truthful active-plan counts, and picks up new snapshots, plans, and repository changes without a manual refresh.

risks.title: Periodic refetching adds local API traffic
risks.mitigation: Polling is limited to snapshot, repository, and plan query prefixes at a five-second interval, while request deduplication remains handled by React Query.

timeline.title: Reproduced stale active-agent and refresh behavior
timeline.summary: Regression tests showed completed snapshots were converted into active-agent rows and live query defaults were absent.

timeline.title: Corrected active-work semantics and live updates
timeline.summary: Active agents now come from locked plans; live data polls, dynamic JSON is no-store, and the snapshot index signature includes snapshot directory state.

timeline.title: Verified automated and browser behavior
timeline.summary: All Go and UI tests passed, the production bundle built, and Playwright confirmed zero active agents, repeated background API requests, no-store responses, and no console errors.

decisions.title: Use locked plans as the active-work signal
decisions.rationale: EVE records snapshots only after completion and does not own agent processes, so completed snapshots cannot truthfully indicate a running agent. A locked, unfulfilled plan is the available durable signal for implementation in progress.

decisions.title: Poll only live query families
decisions.rationale: Snapshot, repository, and plan request lists need automatic freshness; immutable details and expensive code/transcript queries do not need global polling.

validation.output: TypeScript check and Vite production build completed successfully.

validation.command: Playwright local dashboard smoke check on http://127.0.0.1:4318
validation.output: Overview rendered 0 running agents and 0 active plans; snapshots, repositories, and plans refetched repeatedly; snapshot responses included Cache-Control: no-store; console had 0 errors and 0 warnings.
